answer.reason: The verses give two chief events for Ittai: his vow to follow David into exile and his command of a third of David's army.

clauses.english: vowed to stay with David, in death or life, when he fled from Absalom
clauses.quote: whether in death or life, even there also will thy servant be

clauses.english: was given command of a third of David's army against Absalom
clauses.quote: a third part under the hand of Ittai the Gittite

doubts: 2SA 15:19-22 is cited from the verses that name Ittai; the context verse 15:20 is not needed for the clause.
